_comment: Agentic voice-loop pools. Router: 3-way (direct/think/decide) with tool use folded into think. Feedback: pre-answer filler spoken when route != direct. Backchannel: mid-speech listening cues. Texts are git-tracked; embeddings are recorded from the serving model by tools/record_router.py into models/router_embeddings.npz (re-record on any serving-numerics change, same rule as decide sigs).

direct: How many days are in a week?
What's the freezing point of water?
What color is the sky on a clear day?
think: If I leave at 5pm and the drive takes 3 hours, when will I arrive?
Plan a three-day trip to Tokyo.
How many seconds are there in a leap year?
Write a short story about a dragon.
Walk me through why the experiment failed.
Explain the difference between HTTP and HTTPS.
Remind me to call mom when I get home.
If a train travels 60 kilometers per hour for 90 minutes, how far does it go?
Search for flights to Denver next week.
Draft an email to my landlord about the leak.
How much paint do I need for a 12 by 15 foot room?
decide: Should I take the bus or walk?
Which is better, Python or JavaScript?
What should I have for dinner tonight?
